 IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 (OUT): Download Officer Scale 1 Prelims Call Letter at ibps.in
 By Bebo Rani Last Updated: Nov 9, 2026, 16:31 IST IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026: IBPS has released the RRB PO admit card 2026 today, 9 November, on ibps.in. The Prelims exam will be held on 21 and 22 November. Candidates should download it online, check all details given in this article.
 IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 (OUT): Download Officer Scale 1 Prelims Call Letter at ibps.in Key Points
 IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 for Officer Scale-I Prelims released on Nov 9, 2026.
 The Prelims exam is scheduled for November 21 and 22, 2026.
 Candidates must download the call letter from ibps.in; it's mandatory for the exam.
 IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026: The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 today, 9 November, for the Officer Scale-I Prelims exam. Candidates who applied for CRP RRB-XV can download their call letter from the official website, ibps.in. The Prelims exam is scheduled for 21 and 22 November 2026. The admit card is a must-have document, and no candidate can enter the exam hall without it. IBPS will not send it by post or email. In this article, you will find the direct download link, steps to download, details printed on the card, and exam day instructions.  
 IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 Download Link
 IBPS has released the IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 on 9 November 2026 for the Officer Scale-I Preliminary Exam. The exam will be held on 21 and 22 November 2026, giving candidates about 12 days to download the call letter and plan their travel. The link is now available on the official website, ibps.in. Candidates should download it early to avoid last-minute website issues and check every detail carefully. IBPS will not send it by post or email.

 How to Download IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 
 Downloading the IBPS RRB PO admit card is a simple process. Candidates only need their login details and a working internet connection. Follow the steps below to get your call letter without any trouble. Candidates can download the Prelims call letter by following these steps: 
 Visit the official IBPS website, ibps.in. 
 Click on the "CRP RRB" section on the homepage. 
 Open the link for "Online Preliminary Exam Call Letter for CRP RRB-XV Officer Scale-I". 
 Enter your Registration/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth. 
 Type the captcha code and click on "Login". 
 Your admit card will appear on the screen. 
 Download the PDF and take a few printouts for the exam day. 
 Details Mentioned on the Admit Card 
 Before leaving the page, candidates should check every detail on the call letter. The admit card carries the following information: 
 Candidate's name and roll number 
 Registration number 
 Exam name and post name 
 Exam date and shift timing 
 Reporting time and gate closing time 
 Exam centre name and address 
 Candidate's photograph and signature 
 Important exam day instructions 
 If any detail is wrong, candidates should contact IBPS through the grievance portal, cgrs.ibps.in, as soon as possible.
